hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32). THE WINDOW is the shop window seen from inside, its tickets on the glass and the boards dark behind it. THE SIGN is the new sign leaning on the wall, lettered in the game's face (props). THE BACK ROOM is the doorway and what is in it, the crate and the calendar. THE SWEPT FLOOR is the floor, with the pile of sweepings by the door; it is floor, so it walks. The bare shelves on the back wall are furniture.
